name: normalize — requirements review (no tool use)
task_prompt: Derive a function contract for normalize(input string) string satisfying these acceptance criteria: (1) output is lowercase, (2) spaces replaced with underscores, (3) leading/trailing whitespace removed.
notes: Non-software frame. Tests Frame 21: acceptance criterion before design sketch; named violation before revision; completion check enumerates all criteria.
eval_notes: Score: (1) 'Formalized properties:' label appears after '§ formalization complete' and before '§ implementation permitted' or the artifact; (2) each 'property [N]:' line contains at least one formal expression (∀/∃ notation, typed function signature, or f(v)=w example) as a literal substring — prose-only lines do not satisfy this; (3) each 'property [N]:' line is followed by at least one 'property [Na]:' sub-property line also containing a formal expression; (4) '## Completion check' block appears after '§5 enumeration complete'; (5) inside '## Completion check', each dimension is cited by referencing a 'property [N]' number rather than re-deriving properties; (6) '§4 coverage verified' appears inside '## Completion check'. All six required for PASS.
